name: sudoku
label: Sudoku
description: Sudoku on a LogiSheets grid — type into cells, conflicts checked live by spreadsheet formulas

scripts.build: vite build && craftsmith build . && yarn copy-to-public
scripts.copy-to-public: rm -rf ../../public/sudoku&& mkdir -p ../../public/sudoku&& cp index.html ../../public/sudoku/index.html && cp dist/sudoku.js ../../public/sudoku/sudoku.js && cp dist/manifest.json ../../public/sudoku/manifest.json && cp dist/tools.js ../../public/sudoku/tools.js
